project.name: StudyPlan Demo 01
project.description: A tiny dependency-free daily study planner. Automated tutorial operated by BotSquad Demo Operator.
project.instructions: StudyPlan tutorial operated by BotSquad Demo Operator (automation, not a named human). The planner and report formatter are naturally separate scopes under src/planner/ and src/report/. Engineers should write tests alongside their own module. Managers decide assignments and review normally. The full recipe runs both module suites. Save the final example as a trusted task artifact; do not run a separate shell demo.

workers.title: CEO
workers.mission: Build and coordinate useful software/product work through bounded subordinate workers. Create specialists when needed. Assign and evaluate work. Report important outcomes and blockers to the human owner.

workers.title: DevOps
workers.mission: Coordinate exact scoped worker infrastructure through trusted human approvals. No root or arbitrary shell.

workers.title: Product Manager
workers.mission: Produce concrete product specifications for assigned projects.

workers.title: CTO
workers.mission: Manage bounded engineering delivery, independent review, and trusted integration.

workers.title: Software Engineer
workers.mission: Implement and validate StudyPlan planner within src/planner/.

workers.title: Software Engineer
workers.mission: Implement and validate StudyPlan report formatter within src/report/.

workers.title: Independent Reviewer
workers.mission: Independently review exact StudyPlan submissions against corrected subject/tasks contract.

Focused report recipe passed 13/13. Changes only src/report/report.mjs and report.test.mjs.
